items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My auntie’s loved [Jimmie] Lunceford and Basie.

ctx.x: [asks about music Liston heard, including Count Basie and Cab Calloway.]
My pop’s favorite was Cab Calloway. My auntie’s loved [Jimmie] Lunceford and Basie.
[asks about Liston starting music at the age of 3 or 4.]
